name: com.hybridracedata/hyrox
title: Hybrid Race Data: HYROX results
description: Every HYROX result: athlete search, splits, ratings, course speed, records and race plans.

tools.name: search
tools.description: Find HYROX athletes by name or race weekends by city. Returns slugs/ids for the other tools.

query.description: Athlete name or city, e.g. 'Hunter McIntyre' or 'London 2026'

tools.name: get_athlete
tools.description: An athlete's HYROX race history: every result with time, place, age-group place, division and partners, plus Hybrid Rating.

tools.name: get_result
tools.description: Full splits of one result (8 runs, 8 stations, Roxzone), place after each segment and rank per segment.

id.description: Result id from get_athlete or get_race_results

tools.name: get_event
tools.description: A HYROX race weekend: dates, venue, divisions with finishers, winners, median and top-10% times, course speed.

id.description: Event id, e.g. 'london-2026' (from search or list_events)

tools.name: list_events
tools.description: Recent or upcoming HYROX race weekends, optionally filtered by city or country.

tools.name: get_race_results
tools.description: Finishers of one division at one event, in finishing order, with optional name search and age group.

tools.name: time_benchmarks
tools.description: Median, top-25%, top-10% and fastest finish and station times for a division (last two seasons), optionally for an age group, and where a given time ranks.

division.description: open | pro | doubles | pro doubles (default open)

time.description: A finish time like '1:24:30' to place in the field (optional)

tools.name: split_plan
tools.description: Run and station splits that real Open athletes used to finish around a target time.

tools.name: upcoming_races
tools.description: Upcoming HYROX race weekends with dates, venue and ticket status (on sale / sold out / not yet on sale), with a link to set a ticket alert on Race Radar.
